import os
from cyhole.solscan import Solscan

# Read API key from environment
api_key = os.getenv("SOLSCAN_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("SOLSCAN_API_KEY environment variable not set")

# Initialize Solscan client with V2
solscan = Solscan(api_key=api_key, version="v2")

# Example token address (SOL token on Solana)
token_address = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"

# Fetch historical price data synchronously
historical_data = solscan.get_token_price_history(
    token_address=token_address,
    time_range="24h"  # Can be: 1h, 4h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, max
)

# Display the results
print(f"Historical price data for {token_address}:")
print(historical_data)
